symbols.name: IllegalPick

symbols.name: _field_path
symbols.doc: A dotted field path → the text[] value bound to ``#>`` (AC-28).

symbols.name: _compile_expression
symbols.doc: parse → gate → compile, in that order, always (§4.5: the gate runs before compile_ast, on the parsed tree, every time).

symbols.name: _bind_ctx_values

symbols.name: _Pieces
symbols.doc: The shared prep every shape starts from.

symbols.name: numeric_source
symbols.doc: §7.2 item 5's `<j>`: a bound path, or a computed column's compiled expression re-emitted inline (B2) — never an alias, never SQL text.

symbols.name: rolling_column
symbols.doc: Op 8's SELECT-list entry (R14: width 3, trailing, a mean).

symbols.name: order_by
symbols.doc: §7.4 — the total order every multi-row result carries; the last component is always ``key ASC`` (AC-41(a)), the tiebreak ascending whichever way the sort field runs (§7.4(1a)).

symbols.name: aggregate_call
symbols.doc: Op 6's one emitted value (shapes C and D): the chosen function over the numeric read, in ``numeric`` end to end (§7.2, AC-24(c)). ``sum``/``avg`` are rounded half-up to 6 places; ``min``/``max`` take no round; ``count`` is the exception — it counts rows and takes no field (legality refuses a count that carries one).

symbols.name: _shape_rows
symbols.doc: Shape A — ROWS, no operation 9 (plan §4.2). No CTE: a window function in the SELECT list needs no wrapping.

symbols.name: _shape_rows_changed
symbols.doc: Shape B — ROWS with operation 9: B3's CTE, written out in full there.

symbols.name: _shape_scalar
symbols.doc: Shape C — SCALAR (plan §4.2). One row: no ORDER BY, no LIMIT (legality disables ops 4 and 5). Computed columns are defined, not emitted — B2 removed the 42703 by construction.

symbols.name: _shape_bucket
symbols.doc: Shape D — BUCKET: B1's statement, exactly. ONE emitted ``bucket`` column — the text label — so ``ORDER BY "bucket"`` cannot be ambiguous; text order on the fixed-width UTC label IS time order (R15, C collation). B1 writes this shape without a table alias; the shared pieces compiled every fragment unqualified for it (``_Pieces.col``).

symbols.name: build
symbols.doc: One pick → one parameterised statement (plan §4.2's four shapes).
